research_question: What is the effect of family-based interventions, compared with standard care, on caregiver burden measured at 1 month or less post-intervention, for families of people with schizophrenia or severe mental illness?
outcome_description: Caregiver burden measured at 1 month or less post-intervention using standard caregiver burden scales (pooling post-intervention endpoint means and pre-to-post change scores)
positive_direction: A positive effect size indicates greater reduction in caregiver burden (lower burden) favoring the family-based intervention over standard care
search_queries: family intervention schizophrenia caregiver burden trial
family psychoeducation severe mental illness caregiver burden controlled
family support intervention psychosis caregiver burden outcome
inclusion_criteria: Empirical comparative studies (e.g., randomized or non-randomized controlled trials) of family-based interventions versus standard care for families or caregivers of individuals with schizophrenia or severe mental illness
Quantitative reporting of caregiver burden measured at 1 month or less post-intervention (including endpoint means and/or pre-to-post change scores)
exclusion_criteria: Not an original empirical study (systematic reviews, meta-analyses, editorials, opinion pieces, and theoretical papers are excluded)
No comparison between a family-based intervention and a control condition
No quantitative caregiver burden outcome data that can produce an effect size (means, SDs, or change scores required)
Completely unrelated to schizophrenia/severe mental illness family interventions, or reporting caregiver burden only at follow-ups beyond 1 month post-intervention
moderators_to_extract: Intervention modality (psychoeducation vs systemic family therapy vs mutual support)
Delivery format (individual family vs multi-family group)
Specific caregiver burden instrument (e.g., Zarit Burden Interview)
Data type (post-intervention endpoint mean vs pre-to-post change score)
Patient diagnostic population (schizophrenia vs broad severe mental illness)
effect_size_note: Both post-intervention endpoint scores and pre-to-post change scores are pooled together at the <= 1 month timepoint using Mean Difference (MD) as requested.
